objective: Define and persist a minimal River-owned correlation record that links one canonical InsuranceContactAttempt to an operator or lead Telnyx call-control reference without making provider identity canonical.
rules: A contact attempt may have at most one operator leg and one lead leg.
A provider call-control reference may correlate to only one River attempt/leg record.
Provider call-control references never replace InsuranceContactAttemptId.
call_session_id and call_leg_id remain optional provider evidence outside canonical identity.
Correlation persistence is additive and does not mutate existing contact-attempt providerReference semantics.
next: INS-002E2C2 can make normalized Telnyx event resolution correlation-aware by resolving call_control_id through this additive leg-correlation persistence before bridge lifecycle reconciliation.
